description: Web-only editorial cards derived from public materials by Maxim Ilyakhov. These cards supplement but do not change the canonical ILY-R01..ILY-R102 book identities or their automation counts.

rules.trigger: A company or organization states a value mainly as self-evaluation without showing what changes in practice.
rules.operation: Look for an observable behavior, procedure, limitation or trade-off caused by the stated value; surface only evidence already supplied.
rules.guard: A concise values list can be legitimate when operational examples live elsewhere; never fabricate a company practice.

rules.trigger: A stylistic rule, tool recommendation or detector-avoidance heuristic has been applied mechanically and the result is less natural, precise or readable Russian.
rules.operation: Compare the edited form with a natural contextual alternative and restore functional pronouns, connective material, punctuation, syntax or rhythm. Never damage normal Russian merely to make a text look less machine-generated.
rules.guard: Do not use anti-dogmatism to excuse empty corporate filler or real language errors.

rules.trigger: Decorative or metaphorical language in informational or persuasive prose may replace rather than carry a meaningful claim.
rules.operation: Check genre fit, freshness/non-cliche status and whether a meaningful proposition remains under the image.
rules.guard: Literary, personal, comic and rhetorical prose may use imagery as a primary function; never flatten author voice merely to imitate information style.
